address: 50 rue de la Halle, Lille, 59800, France
bio: In the heart of Vieux Lille, local man Steven Ramon confirms – after his Top Chef adventure in 2014 – that we should be counting on him in the future. A Ch'ti to the core, he concocts inspired and lively dishes that make the most of fine ingredients. The restaurant has a rouge barre interior (red brick and white stone). Irresistible!...
